sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-30; recorded verbatim. Said in reply to Claude Code's offer to file SP-135..137 and their remedies as one holon in srs-context. It contradicts the practice running today: srs-programme CLAUDE.md ('Agents never write into Affirmed or Set aside') and the clerk handbook, The affirmation layer ('Affirmation is how the owner turns a suggestion ... into an affirmed record').
